audience: HR, payroll and operations teams that use WebClock for time clock and timesheet data

useCases.title: See who is in and who is out now
useCases.text: Check the current in or out status of each employee, with the last in and last out times and the time-off flag. Read the employee list with its pay group and department.

useCases.title: Review timesheets for a pay period
useCases.text: Read the timesheet hours by pay code, client and task, with lock and approval status. Compare them with the raw punch times for the same dates.

useCases.title: Find shifts with missing punches
useCases.text: List shift anomalies such as missing punches for a date range. Read the time-clock records of the same days to check them.

useCases.title: Check accrual balances and time-off requests
useCases.text: Read the accrual balance of each employee and accrual type. List the time-off requests in a date range, filtered by status or employee.

useCases.title: Prepare payroll-ready data for one pay group
useCases.text: Read units, rates, pay codes and PTO balance for one pay group over a date range. Add time totals per week or month for the same period.
